scientific_integrity: A complete algebraic argument and a standalone finite exact-rational consistency checker are supplied. Priority is limited by literature-coverage risk; no independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to a one-mode real bilinear zero-sum game with positive two-point multiplier noise, fixed common predictor/corrector step, equal prescribed marginals and independent pairs across iterations; mean-square conclusions do not imply almost-sure stability or general-dimensional performance.
title: A sharp coupling-reversal frontier for stochastic extragradient on a bilinear game
